ld.name: Solgar, Omega 3 Fish Oil Concentrate, 120 Softgels
ld.description: Since 1947 Purified to Remove Mercury Non-GMO Gluten, Wheat & Dairy Free Dietary Supplement This formulation provides a natural, concentrated source of Omega 3 fatty acids EPA and DHA from deep-sea, cold-water fish. EPA and DHA support cardiovascular, joint and metabolic health. The fish oil in this formulation is tested for optimum purity. It undergoes molecular distillation to remove mercury.

blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: This formulation provides a natural, concentrated source of Omega 3 fatty acids EPA and DHA from deep-sea, cold-water fish. EPA and DHA support cardiovascular, joint and metabolic health. The fish oil in this formulation is tested for optimum purity. It undergoes molecular distillation to remove mercury.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: As a dietary supplement for adults, take two (2) softgels three times daily, preferably with meals or as directed by a healthcare practitioner.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Gelatin, vegetable glycerin, natural mixed tocopherols.
Free of: gluten, wheat, dairy, yeast, sugar, sodium, artificial flavor, sweetener, and color.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: If you are pregnant, nursing, taking any medications, including blood thinners, planning any medical or surgical procedure or have any medical condition, please consult your healthcare practitioner before taking any dietary supplement. Discontinue use and consult your healthcare practitioner if any adverse reactions occur. Keep out of reach of children. Store at room temperature. Do not use if outer bottle seal is missing or damaged.
